from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of a person or entity involved in the case")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Role of the party, e.g., appellant, defendant, applicant")

class MonetaryDetail(BaseModel):
    amount: float | None = Field(description="Numerical value of the amount")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency, typically '人民币'")
    description: str | None = Field(description="Description of the amount, e.g., fine, court fee, restitution")

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    document_id: str = Field(description="Identifier of the document from the task")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of case, e.g., Criminal, Civil, Administrative")
    procedure_type: str | None = Field(description="Procedural stage, e.g., Appeal, Reconsideration, Retrial")
    case_numbers: list[str] = Field(description="Official case citation numbers found in the document")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of parties involved in the case")
    monetary_items: list[MonetaryDetail] = Field(description="Fines, fees, or other monetary amounts mentioned")
    ruling_summary: str | None = Field(description="Summary of the court's ruling outcome")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
